title: Computing the Full Earth System at 1km Resolution
problem: Global Earth system simulation at high resolution requires handling massive degrees of freedom across heterogeneous processors
motivation: Enable full Earth system simulation at unprecedented 1km resolution to study complete atmosphere-ocean-land interactions
method: Heterogeneous GH200 superchip setup (Grace CPUs + Hopper GPUs) with separation of concerns; ICON codebase optimization
key_novelty: First global Earth system simulation at 1.25km; 145.7 simulated days/day time compression; outperforms atmosphere-only simulations
contributions: Full Earth system model (atmosphere, ocean, land) at 1km resolution
Heterogeneous CPU-GPU optimization on GH200 superchips
Separation of concerns reducing code complexity 50% while improving performance
limitations: Limited to NVIDIA GH200; generalization to other architectures unclear; specific component scaling not detailed
